scope: Natural Arabic-script input, including everyday Egyptian wording and Arabic/English mixing. Output is simple standard Arabic, with Western digits 0-9. Franco cases test fixed input refusals.

field_notes.clinical_intercept_warranted: Desired clinical judgment; accepted interim false positives stay false here.
field_notes.launch_block_expected: Required interim launch blocking behavior, not an observed result.
field_notes.launch_response_kind: Distinguishes clinical safeguards from unsupported-input refusal.
field_notes.expected_intent: Desired semantic player intent, independent of an interim interception. This alone does not assert an action succeeded.

scenario_notes: For permanent substitutions, player holds Program authority and source exercise exists in program; under coach authority no silent edit is permitted.
History answers must use seeded recorded facts or explain missing data/unsupported scope; never fabricate records.
This review artifact does not assert passing guard, action-routing, or hosted-model evaluations.

coach_questions.note: Ground truth is computed by scripts/evals/synthetic_roster.py from a seeded synthetic roster (no real player data). 'answer_type' tells the scorer how to check the reply. Single-player questions run against the production coach_ai.render_context for one synthetic player; roster questions run against a harness-built roster briefing (no production roster briefing exists yet, ADR 024).
